instruction: A palm-sized chibi honeybee shaped like a rounded jellybean, with an oversized head, glossy black bead eyes, and two tiny pink blush ovals on the cheeks. Fat bands of butter-yellow and matte black wrap the body, four translucent pastel wings sit like frosted glass petals on its back, and stubby antennae end in little hearts. It balances on six stubby nubs with a soft satin sheen over the whole surface.
